intended_use: AI developer input for Flutter app and server catalog; human review required
IMPORTANT_LIMITATIONS: NOT a complete catalog of all world makes/models or phone variants.
Curated examples are seed candidates; no per-model real-time manufacturer verification was performed.
Do not claim a field or model has been verified unless source and model variant are checked.
No copyrighted competitor data, photos, or private APIs are bundled.
Official/third-party webpages referenced for design research; bulk reuse needs authorization.

schema_rules: Every field has stable key and localized labels
Search filters generated from indexable form values
Version and migrate schema rather than overwrite old listings

location_reference.warning: City seed is not a comprehensive official hierarchy. Verify parent regions, spellings and changes before publication.

vehicle_makes_models.recommended_authoritative_import: NHTSA vPIC GetAllMakes/GetModelsForMake; regional and manufacturer sources to fill gaps
vehicle_makes_models.variant_policy: generation/year/engine not populated; must verify before offering as constrained model choices

smartphone_brands_models.variant_policy: Do not generate capacity/RAM combinations from a global list. Only offer verified device-specific configurations.
smartphone_brands_models.source_strategy: Official Apple/Samsung/brand product spec pages; licensed datasets if available

vehicles.source: Somon.tj vehicle filters; NHTSA models coverage differs by US market

business_validation: map location not reveal exact residence by default
real_estate.important_notice: Tajikistan land rights differ from ownership of physical improvements; do not assert legal title without specialist review.

electronics.smartphone_storage_policy: model-specific verified storage only; none of the starter phone models include vetted storage options

jobs.vacancy_vs_resume: separate publication flow and safe contact privacy

fashion.size_policy: do not infer equivalences without actual size chart per manufacturer

kids.used_car_seat_safety: request accident history and expiry/production date where applicable

animals_plants.moderation: no protected wildlife or illegal trade

order: vehicle makes and models via vPIC API + non-US local manufacturer sources
model-specific phone storage and RAM variants
computer and appliance manufacturers and models
future_catalog_ingestion_plan.release_rule: No bulk import without licensing check, schema integrity checks and duplicate normalization.
future_catalog_ingestion_plan.remote_catalog: versioned API data, searchable server index, local offline cache, incremental sync, rollback on bad import
future_catalog_ingestion_plan.manual_fallback: Other / not listed with unverified free text, reviewed by moderator
